ModMetaData.description: A DEMONSTRATION mod, not campaign content. It exists to answer one question the owner asked on 2026-09-02: can the bridge drive RimWorld's whole reproduction chain — pregnancy, induced birth, an egg laid, and that egg hatching into a baby Jawa? LIVE_BIRTH_AND_HATCH_DEMO_1. Delete it once the answer is recorded.
